synopsis: ISO/IEC TS 22440-2 is the Guidance part of the AI functional safety series, alongside Part 1 (Requirements) and Part 3 (Examples of application); all three were committee drafts in 2026 [f2384, f2728, f15300]. The drafts were registered on 9 February 2026, and their comment period closed on 11 April 2026 [f2385]. Both Chapter 3 and the glossary judge publication much before 2027 or 2028 unlikely, explicitly linking that uncertainty to committee-draft status [f2386, f15300]. For validation planning, the testing provisions remain draft provisions, rather than finalized requirements [f2729].
